audit.whatIsWrong: The page names Heimerdinger's E 'CH-3X' in four places and claims Smoke Screen 'blinds' his turret-fed poke.
audit.why: Riot's name for the E is CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade (11s flat at all ranks, 970 range). Smoke Screen reduces sight range and applies impact damage plus a brief slow — it does not blind autos and does nothing to turret beams.
audit.corrected: Every CH-3X replaced with CH-2 and its flat 11s cooldown used as the commit trigger; Smoke Screen restated as a sight cut plus slow. Quickdraw given its real 16/15/14/13/12s cooldown, which his autos reduce.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart read Skill, Heimerdinger, Heimerdinger, Skill, Skill, Heimerdinger, Heimerdinger in both layers, contradicting the packet chart and the page's own whys.
audit.why: The whys already say Level 1 is Heimerdinger's, Level 3 is where Graves starts out-trading the nest, and the first item spike is his. The packet chart and the audited mirror agree.
audit.corrected: Chart flipped as one atomic pair-set to Heimerdinger, Skill, Graves, Skill, Graves, Graves, Heimerdinger across phases[].side and win[].

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4] and phases[5] were labelled Skill/Heimerdinger despite the text describing Graves owning the level 6 all-in and the first-item window.
audit.why: Heimerdinger's R is a 100/85/70s upgrade he can be baited off; Graves's Collateral Damage is 100/80/60 and his first hybrid-tank item lets him eat a beam and still burst the yordle off the nest before Liandry's completes.
audit.corrected: phases[4] and phases[5] restated to Graves with the R cooldown and the item timing as the reason; phases[0] restated to Heimerdinger on the no-Quickdraw level 1.

edits.before: One turret + AA wins level 1 against almost everyone. Identify how Graves contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Graves has no Quickdraw at 1, so your turret plus an auto wins first contact — but no stun until 3, so don't chase his poke.

edits.before: Three turrets make your half of lane a no-entry zone. Only take the trade when Graves's Quickdraw is down.
edits.after: He gets Quickdraw here — 16s at rank 1, shorter as he autos. Trade only while that dash is down.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Graves must walk into your range.
edits.after: Quickdraw dashes his shotgun past the turret line and End of the Line lands before your beams stack — this window is his.

edits.before: Upgraded E or W deletes his all-in — choose per fight. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Graves's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: UPGRADE!!! widens CH-2, but Collateral Damage plus shotgun burst beats a 100s ult he can bait out — his all-in wins here.

edits.before: Liandry's Torment is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Quickdraw's cooldown.
edits.after: His first hybrid-tank item walks through beam damage and bursts you off the nest before Liandry's completes.

edits.before: Whether his Quickdraw dive beats my CH-3X center-stun is pure execution: read the dash and I freeze him for the W-and-beam punish; whiff it and I'm immobile and dead — neither side owns this window by default.
edits.after: Whether his Quickdraw dive beats my CH-2 center-stun is pure execution: read the dash and I freeze him for the rocket-and-beam punish; whiff it and an 11s recharge leaves me immobile and dead — neither side owns this.

edits.before: His shotgun burst plus Smoke Screen blind let him farm safely and chip me off my beams, and a single CH-3X can't zone a Graves who baits it then dashes — he owns the all-in here.
edits.after: His shotgun burst plus Smoke Screen's sight cut let him farm safe and chip me off my beams, and one CH-2 on an 11s timer can't zone a Graves who baits it then dashes — he owns the all-in here.

edits.before: UPGRADE!!! a wider, longer-stunning CH-3X grenade and aim the center on the spot he Quickdraws to — that center-stun plus W rockets and three beams is your one window to delete a committed Graves.
edits.after: UPGRADE!!! a wider, longer-stunning CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade and aim its center where he Quickdraws to — that stun plus Micro-Rockets and three beams is your one window to delete a committed Graves.

edits.before: Once Graves has Quickdraw this becomes a pure skill standoff — he can dash past my turret line and unload shotgun autos plus End of the Line before my beams stack, but if I read the dash my CH-3X center-stun freezes him for the W-rocket-and-beam punish. The whole lane lives on that one grenade: hold it for his commit, never throw it just to poke. Respect Smoke Screen — it blinds my turret-fed pokes and zones me off my own nest, so reset the wave under tower rather than fight blind in the cloud. At 6 my UPGRADE!!! widens the stun and gives me the better all-in, but a Graves who baits the grenade first still out-trades me, so it stays a coinflip on who lands their cooldown.
edits.after: Once Graves has Quickdraw this becomes a pure skill standoff — he can dash past my turret line and unload shotgun autos plus End of the Line before my beams stack, but if I read the dash my CH-2 center-stun freezes him for the rocket-and-beam punish. The whole lane lives on that one grenade: 11s at every rank, so hold it for his commit, never throw it to poke. Smoke Screen does not blind my turrets — it cuts my sight and slows, so I fight from outside the cloud instead of guessing inside it. At 6 my UPGRADE!!! widens the stun and gives me the better all-in, but a Graves who baits the grenade first still out-trades me, so it stays a coinflip on who lands their cooldown.

edits.before: Throw Smoke Screen onto your nest to blind your turret-fed poke and zone you off your own beams while he farms
edits.after: Throw Smoke Screen over your nest to cut your sight and slow you off your own beams, then farm while you guess

notes: Kit-flag misfire recorded, not asserted on the page: graves Q carries terrain:'creates terrain, blocks paths and dashes'. Riot's own description says the shell detonates after 1 second OR on colliding with terrain — it does not create terrain. Trusted the description. Heimerdinger's R flags (hardCC/slow/zone/projectile) are inherited from whichever spell it upgrades, not properties of UPGRADE!!! itself. Ratings left untouched — see questionsForUser.
